purpose: Matched validation-only coefficient selection for integrated and post-hoc Stage-3 variants

shared.candidate_set: full development catalog minus learner development-prefix exposures

selection_rule.reference: lambda-zero validation result at the same seed
selection_rule.eligible_set: non-dominated configurations maximizing NDCG@10 and minimizing DVR@10
selection_rule.primary_rule: among eligible configurations with relative NDCG@10 loss <= 1%, select minimum DVR@10
selection_rule.fallback: if none satisfies the 1% NDCG guardrail, select the configuration with the smallest NDCG loss among those with strictly lower DVR; if no configuration lowers DVR, reject the variant

after_selection.tau_sensitivity_semantics: analysis only at the selected coefficient; it cannot revise coefficient selection
after_selection.test_policy: no test access until coefficient selection, multi-seed validation, sensitivity analysis, and full design freeze are complete
